text:
alex: Canary noticed users unexpectedly switching from SSE to polling. Console route_split ~0.5 but polling traffic spikes. Anyone else?

maria: Yep, saw duplicate billing for resumed sessions. Seems client resume + fallback polling both counted.

ben: Any specific log marker? Edge logs show a fallback event with reason=FALLBACK_THROTTLE for some sessions.

alex: Example: {event:fallback,reason:FALLBACK_THROTTLE,route_split:0.47,session:abc123,proxy=edge-eu-4}

jamie: Routing flips to polling when per-route backlog >80% for >5s. Problem: console aggregates route_split but doesn't surface fallback_reason or migrated_to_polling, so ops can't filter.

maria: Client also ignores resume idempotency header, so retries create new billing streams. Two fixes: propagate X-Resume-Idempotency on resume and increase polling TTL behind canary.

ben: Telemetry fix: emit sse.fallback_reason tag with route_id/proxy_zone/rollout_tag and a migrated_to_polling flag in route logs.

jamie: Short-term hotfix: for canary, enable sticky-route=true for 60s on FALLBACK_THROTTLE to avoid duplicate consumers. Gate behind rollout flag.

ops-bot: [auto] Created REDWOOD-1067 telemetry ticket and duplicate-billing alert (count>3 in 10m).

alex: Action items assigned in thread. Monitor 48h; revert changes if spikes continue.
